title: Clear baggy arrived with no pic, no description or instructions
text:
Clear baggy arrived with no pic, no description or instructions. I had originally purchased these to give as a Christmas gift to my son who has a lot of hats. when they arrived it was just a stack of black-and-white in a baggy, no description, no instructions, absolutely nothing but a plain clear baggy. so there was no way of knowing what they were Unless you purchased them.
I ended up giving them to my son as a just because and sent him the link so he could see what it was.

My Son has installed the Hat hooks. He waited 24 hours before using them so they adhere better. He said that is what similar items recommend. He's very happy with them. Hung a few of wives empty purses as well

product_metadata.title: Adhesive Hat Hooks for Wall - Hat Racks for Baseball Caps - Hat Organizer for Baseball Caps - Minimalist Hat Rack Design, No Drilling, Strong Hold Hat Hangers (12 Pcs - Black & White)
features: MINIMALIST, LOW PROFILE DESIGN - Our hat holder is designed to showcase your hats, not the hook. When your hats are hanging, our hooks are mostly hidden from view.

DURABLE & STRONG - Wall hat rack uses strong adhesive that holds up to 3 pounds. CAUTION: We use a strong adhesive to ensure your hooks stay mounted over time. Due to strong adhesive, please place the hook on a surface that does not tear. Do not use on wallpaper and rough surfaces. Use carefully on drywall and painted walls.

PRESERVE HAT SHAPE - Our hat rack for wall design is curved to keep your hats damage-free. Other conventional hooks or nails put too much weight on a single point on the back of your hat, warping hats.

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL - Elegant hat collection solution for all kinds of hat: bucket hat, cowboy hat, baseball cap, winter hat, sun hat and so on. The hat organizer for baseball caps can also be used headphone hanger, sun glass, handbag, scarf and other house hold items that weighs under 6 lbs.

EXCELLENT HAT ORGANIZER - Imagine a dream-worthy place to put all your baseball hats. Not simply to put away, but to display for all too see. When caps are hanging, our hat rack will disappear from view. You are worthy of a hat rack that is uniquely suitable for your impressive hat storage.
